parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, border/facility restriction or police targeting is documented; hate-speech law covers gender identity since 2020 and anti-discrimination law since 2013, with hate crimes recorded. Social climate is documented as liberal, hostile attitudes decreasing to 11% in 2017, and organised hostility concentrated among extremists, with prime-ministerial condemnation. The 2022 Pride shooting was prosecuted to the maximum 30 years, a positive state response. Recourse is imperfect: reports rose 18% in 2023 to record levels, clearance fell to 45%, only 8% report, and dismissive police treatment is documented. No universal-exposure measure is shown. Border, facilities and detention practice are undocumented open questions, not exposures. This is below consistently effective-protection low-risk, but above friction-only elevated risk.
